editorial.name: Mailchimp
editorial.descriptionZh: 邮件与短信营销平台，建模板、发信、自动化流程和报表都在一个后台。按电商、餐饮、非营利等行业给方案，标配 AI 文案与设计辅助。
editorial.takeawayZh: 从 300+ 模板里改一封邮件，挂上自动化流程发出去
editorial.noteZh: 首屏顶上一整条黄底公告写 Join Mailchimp with a free 14-day trial or save 15% off on 10,000+ contacts.，主标题 Email & SMS marketing minus the learning curve，副题 Drive revenue with intuitive marketing analytics, automations, and AI tools.，一颗 Start Free Trial 黄按钮，背景是压暗的实景照片（成堆纸箱、显示器上贴着 CAT LADY）。标题下压着四星半评分与 Based on 33,000+ reviews、Capterra 4.5 和 TrustRadius 的标。往下三段是 Design with ease（300+ templates、拖拽编辑器）、Get more sales（含 Save up to 42% by switching from Klaviyo to Mailchimp）、Reach your audience on any device（称 Email 与 SMS 同用点击率最高涨 97%），然后是 Connect all your apps 举 Shopify、WooCommerce、Wix，末尾是 Standard 套餐的免费试用块。

reasons.statement: 交付的是让用户自己做邮件与短信内容并投递的平台，站内以 Templates、Content creation tools、Marketing automations 划分功能，属内容创作工具。
站内 /solutions/content-creation-tools 与 /solutions/digital-marketing-templates 说明产出是用户自己的邮件模板与活动，不是收录别人的案例。

pages.title: Email & SMS Marketing Platform | Mailchimp
pages.selectionRationale: 本条目采集于 2026-09-15 的首屏实测；手记描述的就是这一屏。

facts.evidence: Design with ease 段写 300+ templates for different seasons and industries，并配 Intuitive drag-and-drop builder

facts.value: 14 天免费试用，Standard 套餐另有 15% 折扣
facts.evidence: 首屏黄底横幅 Join Mailchimp with a free 14-day trial or save 15% off on 10,000+ contacts. 与 Standard 区块的 Save 15% on the ultimate expert-assisted platform for growth

facts.value: 官方称 Email 与 SMS 同时使用时点击率最高提升 97%
facts.evidence: Reach your audience on any device 段：Mailchimp users saw up to a 97% click rate when they used both Email and SMS
